panels.title: Rising: last 24 hours vs usual
panels.description: times_usual: the share of comments and posts mentioning a term in the last 24 hours, divided by its usual share. Usual blends the term's share in the 7 days before with its share in the platform's background, the r/all sample. Without history yet, the platform-wide share dominates, so this first shows what is distinctive for the group and turns into what is rising as history accumulates. Ignores the time picker. The real trend scoring is on the Trending now dashboard.

targets.rawSql:
WITH
    (SELECT sum(docs) FROM scope_hourly
     WHERE channel IN (SELECT channel FROM channel_groups WHERE group_name = ${group:sqlstring} UNION ALL SELECT channel FROM channels WHERE channel = ${group:sqlstring}) AND $__conditionalAll(channel IN (${channel:singlequote}), $channel) AND $__conditionalAll(doc_type IN (${doc_type:singlequote}), $doc_type) AND hour >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR) AS n_now,
    (SELECT sum(docs) FROM scope_hourly
     WHERE channel IN (SELECT channel FROM channel_groups WHERE group_name = ${group:sqlstring} UNION ALL SELECT channel FROM channels WHERE channel = ${group:sqlstring}) AND $__conditionalAll(channel IN (${channel:singlequote}), $channel) AND $__conditionalAll(doc_type IN (${doc_type:singlequote}), $doc_type)
       AND hour >= now() - INTERVAL 8 DAY AND hour < now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR) AS n_before,
    (SELECT sum(docs) FROM scope_hourly
     WHERE channel IN (SELECT channel FROM channels WHERE background)
       AND hour >= now() - INTERVAL 8 DAY) AS n_background,
    -- how many comments' worth of weight the platform-wide share gets in "usual"
    500 AS prior_weight,
    candidates AS (
        SELECT
            term,
            kind,
            sumIf(docs, hour >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR) AS mentions_24h,
            uniqCombinedMergeIf(12)(authors, hour >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR) AS authors_24h,
            sumIf(docs, hour < now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR) AS mentions_before
        FROM term_hourly
        WHERE channel IN (SELECT channel FROM channel_groups WHERE group_name = ${group:sqlstring} UNION ALL SELECT channel FROM channels WHERE channel = ${group:sqlstring}) AND $__conditionalAll(channel IN (${channel:singlequote}), $channel) AND $__conditionalAll(doc_type IN (${doc_type:singlequote}), $doc_type) AND kind IN (${kind:singlequote}) AND hour >= now() - INTERVAL 8 DAY
        GROUP BY term, kind
        HAVING mentions_24h >= $min_mentions AND authors_24h >= $min_authors
    ),
    background AS (
        SELECT term, kind, sum(docs) AS mentions
        FROM term_hourly
        WHERE channel IN (SELECT channel FROM channels WHERE background)
          AND hour >= now() - INTERVAL 8 DAY
          AND (term, kind) IN (SELECT term, kind FROM candidates)
        GROUP BY term, kind
    )
SELECT
    c.term AS term,
    c.kind AS kind,
    c.mentions_24h AS mentions_24h,
    c.authors_24h AS authors_24h,
    c.mentions_before AS mentions_7d_before,
    b.mentions AS mentions_background,
    (c.mentions_before + prior_weight * (b.mentions + 1) / (n_background + 1))
        / (n_before + prior_weight) AS usual_share,
    round(1000 * c.mentions_24h / n_now, 2) AS per_1000_now,
    round(1000 * usual_share, 2) AS per_1000_usual,
    round(c.mentions_24h / n_now / usual_share, 1) AS times_usual
FROM candidates AS c
LEFT JOIN background AS b USING (term, kind)
ORDER BY times_usual DESC, mentions_24h DESC
LIMIT 200
